annotation_method: Codex visual inspection of each final image; no separate judge API
measurement_policy: Supplied measurements are fictional test-user inputs, not measurements recovered from generated images. Photographed rooms have no supplied measurements.
limitations: 25 small-sample cases; not a representative production-accuracy estimate.
All public cases are single-view; private multiview regressions remain local and outside benchmark totals.
Generated rooms may be easier than real user photographs; report photographed and generated results separately.
Annotations were authored by an LLM after viewing images and are not independently human-validated.
Roof skylights, sloping ceilings and some mixed finishes exceed the current rectangular-room representation.
Several early living-room cases share a warm palette; the rest diversify architecture, size, materials, lighting and layout.
Reference entity IDs are not prescribed to the live model. Repeated items need independent matching before scoring.
Compound counters/vanities/lights may be grouped or segmented; score retained visible features, not an arbitrary part count.
